title: About
intro: I lead data and AI delivery at {company}, teach at BITS Pilani and run {communities} tech communities.
bio: I'm {role} at {company}, where I set the data and AI strategy and build what it needs.

In {years}+ years across travel, banking, finance and e-commerce, I've built and scaled production AI and analytics: LLM apps, RAG, predictive models and real-time data systems on Microsoft Fabric, Azure and Databricks. I take work from problem to production.
M.Tech from BITS Pilani, where I now teach Data Visualisation, Machine Learning and NLP as Guest Faculty. Certified in {certifications}.
Tableau Ambassador in 2025 and 2026. I lead {communities} data and AI communities across Tableau, AWS, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and IBM.
My rule: understand the problem deeply, build the right solution, keep the engineering simple.
